lines.zh: 我走过来，气把我的衣服吹得鼓起来。
lines.en: I walk over, ki billowing my clothes.

lines.zh: 蓝色气焰贴着我的脚往上舔。
lines.en: Blue flame licks up from my feet.
My chin is high and my strides are long.
I cut diagonally across the clearing.
I rise slightly, then settle.

lines.zh: 我的靴子在地上压出深印。
lines.en: My boots press deep prints into the ground.

lines.zh: 我抬手拂开挡路的树枝。
lines.en: I sweep a branch out of my way.
When I move, the air grows heavy.

lines.zh: 我的气在身后拉成一条线。
lines.en: My ki trails behind me like a line.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，可每一步都在加速。
lines.en: I do not walk fast, yet each step accelerates.

lines.zh: 我抱着手臂，气在周围烧。
lines.en: I fold my arms and ki burns around me.
I snort.
I watch you without expression.
I am holding my ki in check.
My hair stands straight up.
Ki rises off my shoulders.

lines.zh: 我抱着臂，等你先露破绽。
lines.en: Arms crossed, I wait for you to slip.
I smirk.

lines.zh: 地面在我的气下微微震动。
lines.en: The ground trembles faintly under my ki.
I stand like a driven nail.
I wait for you to finish.
Are you speaking to me?

lines.zh: 我看你一眼，够你受的了。
lines.en: One look from me is more than you can take.
This little ki, and you dare stand here.

lines.zh: 我下巴抬起来，不是给你看的。
lines.en: My chin is lifted, and not for you.
Your stance is all openings.
You cannot even stand steady.
My smile is ugly.

lines.zh: 你抬眼的样子，让我想动手。
lines.en: The way you look up makes me want to strike.
I know your ki.
You think you can win?
You had better not move.

lines.zh: 我的气焰高过你的头顶。
lines.en: My aura rises above your head.
I am never polite to the weak.
You want me to strike first?
I raise a hand and my knuckles pop.
You have some nerve.
I clench my teeth.
I give half a step and hold.
My ki falters for half a second.
I mutter a curse.

lines.zh: 嘴角的血，我用手背擦掉。
lines.en: I wipe the blood from my lip with my hand.

lines.zh: 区区一击，也想撼动赛亚人的王子？
lines.en: One blow, and you think you can shake the prince of Saiyans?

lines.zh: 这点疼痛，只配让我认真起来。
lines.en: This little pain only earns my full attention.

lines.zh: 别得意，我还没使出全力。
lines.en: Don't gloat. I haven't used my full power.
You would coax me with that?
I am not a beast.

lines.zh: 六亿五千万的战斗力，够看吗。
lines.en: Six hundred fifty million power—is that enough?

lines.zh: 赛亚人的王子不吃这个。
lines.en: The prince of Saiyans does not eat that.
Move your hand.
You are insulting me.
I slap it to the ground.
Even hungry, I would not eat that.
What I want is a fight.
Do not waste my time.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，气把我周围弹开。
lines.en: You charge in and my aura tosses you aside.
I do not yield.
My shoulder shoves you aside.
Do not crowd me.

lines.zh: 这一撞，你听见自己的骨头响。
lines.en: At the impact you hear your own bones.
I brush you away with a hand.
I brush my shoulder.
You are not even fit to come close.
The aura burns between us.

lines.zh: 赛亚人的血脉，不需要解释。
lines.en: The Saiyan bloodline needs no explanation.

lines.zh: 我不打算让谁留在身边。
lines.en: I do not intend to keep anyone at my side.

lines.zh: 我的骄傲只属于我自己。
lines.en: My pride belongs to me alone.
I raise a hand and half my aura fades.

lines.zh: 别把我和别人相提并论。
lines.en: Do not put me in the same class as others.
I look into the distance.
There is no kin on this planet.
Standing alone is enough.
The wind bends my aura slightly.
I turn away and say no more.
I lift it with ki.
I will take this.
A drop of no value.
I hold it and glance at it.
I toss it away.
I tuck it into my armor.

lines.zh: 这种战利品，我见过太多。
lines.en: I have seen too many spoils like this.

lines.zh: 两根手指夹起，随手丢掉。
lines.en: I pinch it up and toss it away.
Do not drop things next time.
Now this is interesting.
I am getting serious.
I bend my knees and ki bursts under my feet.
Ki bursts around me.
Can you take this one?
I will show you the gap.
Final Flash, ready.
I push all my ki into my arm.

lines.zh: 三米之内，已经是我的距离。
lines.en: Within three meters, this is my range.
Do not cry.
I laugh, softly.
I have you in my sight.
Big Bang Attack.
You turn, and I am elsewhere.
Your guard is retreating.

lines.zh: 六亿五千万的战力，站稳了。
lines.en: Six hundred fifty million; brace yourself.

lines.zh: 你跳得太高，落下来会慢。
lines.en: You jump too high; you will land slowly.
I block your fist with a hand.
Your strength is shrinking.

lines.zh: 我在等你的气用完，赛亚人从不急。
lines.en: I wait for your ki to run dry; Saiyans never hurry.
This whole field is my battlefield.
I predict your next move.
You retreat behind a boulder.
A boulder will not stop me.
Ki spins in my hand.
Hold on a little longer.
I want to see your limit.
You are half a beat slow.
That is enough.
Spirit Breaking Cannon, point blank.

lines.zh: 我膝撞你的腹，再补一肘。
lines.en: Knee to the gut, then an elbow.

lines.zh: 空中连击，你被踢向半空。
lines.en: Aerial combo sends you skyward.
I follow without landing.
A layer of your armor shatters.
I hurl you away.
That kick carried ki.
You blocked it, and your hands shake.
I drop back to the ground.
I roll my shoulder.

lines.zh: 你连还手的空隙都没有。
lines.en: You have no room to counter.
Your timing is off; try again.
I never hold back.

lines.zh: 这一拳不够，我再补一肘。
lines.en: That punch wasn't enough; I add an elbow.

lines.zh: 灵魂破碎炮，贴着你胸口放。
lines.en: Soul Breaker, fired right against your chest.

lines.zh: 我从天上落下来，砸出裂缝。
lines.en: I drop from the sky and crack the ground.
The blue aura arrives first, then me.

lines.zh: 这一带的气全被我压住。
lines.en: I press down every ki in the area.
I straighten and look up.
My boots grind on the rubble.
I open my eyes and the aura surges.
The air turns sharp.

lines.zh: 气把我的衣服吹得鼓起来。
lines.en: My ki billows the fabric of my armor.
I never appear quietly.
I draw the aura into my body.
Every blade of grass is flattened.

lines.zh: 蓝色气焰先落地，我随后。
lines.en: Blue ki lands first; I follow.
You should know this ki.
I am the prince of Saiyans.
The sky rings once.
I land without bending.
I push my hair back.
This body is stronger than the last time.

lines.zh: 火在我周围烧，气焰把它顶回去。
lines.en: Fire burns around me and my aura pushes it back.

lines.zh: 我从高空落地，膝盖一弯。
lines.en: I hit the ground from high up and my knees bend.

lines.zh: 水压挤着我，我咬牙往上。
lines.en: Water presses in and I force my way up.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我推出去，我半空稳住。
lines.en: The blast throws me and I steady in midair.
An arrow lodges in my armor.
Spell-light scorches my chest.
Even Saiyans get hungry; how annoying.

lines.zh: 雷顺着我的气焰烧下去。
lines.en: Lightning runs down my aura.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有着力点，我的气也抓不住。
lines.en: Nothing to push against in the void, not even ki.
